name: r-lsp
description: R language server for Claude Code with renv support, tidyverse-aware diagnostics, a column-name check with a schema cache for S3 data and data that flows between scripts and targets, a static call map with diff impact and test reach, a data map with column lineage and the data side of a diff, and hooks that check every change to an R file and stay dormant in a directory without R code.
